text:
Maya: Quick sync — thinking about a 45m webinar focused on the practical cost vs quality tradeoffs when serving LLMs. Goal: actionable knobs (batching, quant, routing) + one short live demo. Who can speak to the quant demo?
Samir: I can do the quant part. propose 8–10 min demo showing 3B FP16 -> 3B INT8 and latency/cost numbers.
Jordan: I can cover routing + fallback (Dedicated -> Hosted). 7 min. also show trace in Console.
Ana: I'll draft the landing copy/abstract. can we pick a customer to join for 5m? social proof helps.
Lee (Cust): happy to join briefly and say why we moved to Dedicated for latency predictability. :+1:
Maya: awesome. rough run-of-show idea: 1) 5m intro + why this matters 2) 10m product + knobs 3) 15m demo (quant + routing failover) 4) 10m customer + q&a. Thoughts?
Samir: timing okay. for demo we need a precomputed set of prompts and a small evaluation harness so output quality diffs are visible in <2m. suggest 5 prompts: summarization, instruction, code, chat, rerank.
Jordan: add a fallback stress test: cut Dedicated capacity mid-demo and show automatic fallback to hosted model variant. we'll need the routing policy set to "latency-first -> fallback-hosted".
Ana: abstract draft: "Practical Inference: How teams balance latency, cost, and quality at scale" — then 3 bullets (knobs, real numbers, demo). I'll post draft by EOD.
Maya: dependencies: 1) rehearsal with speakers on Thurs 2pm PT, 2) ops run to simulate capacity failover on Wed 10am PT 3) assets: one slide with metric baselines, one slide with demo commands, one customer quote.
DevExBot: Reminder: rehearsal room reserved Thu 2pm PT in #greenroom. 30 min slot.
Samir: demo commands I plan to run (local test):
```
# start quant model
rdw serve --model redwood-3b --quant int8 --port 8080
# run eval harness
python tools/eval_harness.py --prompts demo_prompts.json --endpoint http://localhost:8080
```
Jordan: ops checklist for failover simulate: set dedicated pool to drain, then trigger fallback rule in staging console. @DevOps please patch the routing policy TTL to 30s for the sim.
Ana: landing page CTA: "Register — learn how much you can save without breaking your app". I'll A/B subject lines.
Maya: rehearsal goals: smooth handoffs, live demo timings, clear fallback narrative if the demo flaps. If demo dies, fallback plan is to show pre-recorded 2-min clip and continue.
Lee (Cust): I'll prep 2 bullet points about the business impact and one concrete latency stat.
Samir: I'll prepare a small table of token-per-second and cost-per-1M tokens for FP16 vs INT8.
Jordan: can someone own the Q&A triage? we should collect top 5 questions from registration form and have answers on a cheat sheet.
Ana: I'll own Q&A triage + registration form. will share the form draft.
Maya: Perfect. final ask: everyone add 2 demo prompts to demo_prompts.json by Tue EOD. I'll compile and share the rehearsal agenda by Wed morning. :rocket:
Samir: added mine.
Jordan: added mine.
Ana: form draft posted: https://forms.gle/example (will replace with real link).
Maya: thanks team — see you at rehearsal.
